svg.text: DETAIL C: LOCK AND LID CATCH, 2:1
(section through the cam and the hook)
The cam (3) lies on the hook of the catch (34):
the lid cannot be lifted. A quarter turn of the
pharmacy key turns the cam up, clear of the hook.
Checked for a 200 N pry on the lid edge:
(section at the worm axis, 7 above the base, looking down)
Ratio 120:1. Torque at the carousel 19.4 N mm (full of pills);
motor torque needed 0.41 N mm, safety factor 242.
The worm is self-locking: its lead angle (7.9°) is less than
the friction angle (14.0°), so the gear cannot drive the worm.
The flashing light is next to the button, as the brief asks.
The display shows the time, the next dose and the battery.
The button, lens and window flanges are clamped by the
cap (31) on silicone: the panel is sealed.
WBEP Ltd for the health trust
Third angle projection. Drawn from the CAD model with hidden line removal.
